item.text:
Refactored the graph layer to remove duplicated validation and construction rules. [GraphValidation.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/GraphValidation.java:1) now owns edge, vertex, and vertex-count checks, and both [DirectedGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/DirectedGraph.java:20) and [DirectedGraphBuilder.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/DirectedGraphBuilder.java:10) use it instead of carrying their own copies.

I also centralized internal graph materialization in [DirectedGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/DirectedGraph.java:48), so the builder now hands off through one freezing path instead of constructing immutable graph state itself. That keeps the builder focused on mutable assembly and the graph focused on immutable representation.

Verification: `javac *.java` succeeded, and `java TopologicalSortDemo` still prints `0 4 5 1 2 3`.
